# Lug bolt knurl sizes for auto vs manual

## Summary

[Partial] Measure the inside diameter of wheel hub stud holes to find automatic or manual transmission knurl sizes. [t526]

## Tools

- [Partial] Caliper or ruler [t526]

## Tips & gotchas

- Automatic transmission wheels typically have a 12.83mm knurl on lug bolts. [t526]
- Manual transmission wheels typically feature a larger 14.35mm knurl. [t526]
